BiblicalUsage: Rôwm carries the sense of elevation, that is (adverbially) aloft. It stands in Habakkuk 3:10: "…water passed by: the deep uttered his voice…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold rôwm as God's own word, even if it appears only here.
